name: @tonkeeper/core
author: Ton APPS UK Limited <support@tonkeeper.com>
description: Core features and state for tonkeeper web wallet

scripts.generate:sdkV2: rm -fr src/tonApiV2 && docker build -f resource/Dockerfile.apiV2 . -t tonapisdkv2 && docker run --rm --user=$(id -u):$(id -g) -v "$PWD":/local tonapisdkv2
scripts.generate:batteryApi: ./resource/check_github_token.sh && docker build --no-cache --build-arg GITHUB_TOKEN="$GITHUB_TOKEN" -f resource/Dockerfile.batteryApi . -t batteryapi && rm -fr ./src/batteryApi && docker run --rm --user=$(id -u):$(id -g) -v "$PWD":/local batteryapi
scripts.generate:2faApi: ./resource/check_github_token.sh && rm -fr src/2faApi && docker build -f resource/Dockerfile.2faApi . -t 2faapi && docker run --rm --user=$(id -u):$(id -g) -v "$PWD":/local -e GITHUB_TOKEN 2faapi
scripts.generate:tonkeeperApi: ./resource/check_github_token.sh && rm -fr src/tonkeeperApiGenerated && docker build -f resource/Dockerfile.tonkeeperApi . -t tonkeeperapi && docker run --rm --user=$(id -u):$(id -g) -v "$PWD":/local -e GITHUB_TOKEN tonkeeperapi
scripts.generate:swapsApi: ./resource/check_github_token.sh && rm -fr src/swapsApiGenerated && docker build -f resource/Dockerfile.swapsApi . -t swapsapi && docker run --rm --user=$(id -u):$(id -g) -v "$(pwd)":/local -e GITHUB_TOKEN -e SWAPS_BACKEND_BRANCH swapsapi
scripts.generate:multichainApi: rm -fr src/multichainApiGenerated && docker build -f resource/Dockerfile.multichainApi . -t multichainapi && docker run --rm --user=$(id -u):$(id -g) -v "$(pwd)":/local multichainapi
scripts.generate:tradingApi: rm -fr src/tradingApiGenerated && docker build -f resource/Dockerfile.tradingApi . -t tradingapi && docker run --rm --user=$(id -u):$(id -g) -v "$(pwd)":/local tradingapi
